title: Agentic OS skill frontmatter (SKILL.md)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md. Skills share ONE format across both runtimes (Claude and Codex read the same SKILL.md). Unlike agents/commands this schema is OPEN (additionalProperties: true): the skill ecosystem evolves and a closed whitelist is exactly why the legacy quick_validate.py wrongly rejected real skills. We type-check the known keys strictly and let novel keys pass. The markdown body is checked separately by validate.mjs.

name.description: kebab-case identifier; should equal the skill's containing directory name.

description.description: Load signal: 'does X; use when Y + symptoms/triggers'. No angle brackets. Never a workflow recap (that makes agents shortcut the body).

context.description: Execution strategy, e.g. 'fork'. Left as a free string — only one value observed live; an enum here would risk false negatives.

agent.description: Route this skill to a named agent's context.

disable-model-invocation.description: Human-invocable only; the model will not auto-trigger.

mcp_dependencies.description: MCP servers this skill needs. Observed live as a comma-separated string ('mcp-core, mcp-tools'); arrays/objects also accepted.

certification.description: Machine-written records of model-tier eval outcomes and evidence artifacts.
